description: A Proxmox VE cluster node as a module: registered, visible and tested; its OS is still patched by the cluster module (ADR-026 D4 stage 1)
_backup: #662: a node's own configuration is captured by backup:filesystem, the same service a guest uses — a node has been a module since #665, so it consumes it like any other. /etc whole (5.7-5.9 MB, ~750 files on a live cluster) rather than a list of subdirectories that goes stale the first time Proxmox puts something important somewhere new; config.db because /etc/pve is a FUSE view of pmxcfs and copying those files back into a running cluster is not a restore; /root minus the netboot ISOs, which make-install-media.sh rebuilds and upstream still serves (3.2 GB of them on one node).
